limits: SetBkMode, SetTextColor and DrawTextA are native platform fixtures; no game text selection or drawing policy is replaced.
timeGetTime is a native clock fixture controlling the original bounded retry delay.
SetRect is a physical rectangle fixture reached through unchanged original layout selection.
RegQueryValueExA is a physical registry fixture reached through unchanged original preference lookup.
GetLastError is a physical thread-state fixture reached through unchanged original CRT.
TlsGetValue is a physical thread-state fixture reached through unchanged original CRT.
SetLastError is a physical thread-state fixture reached through unchanged original CRT.
lstrlenA is a physical native string/atomic fixture reached through unchanged original CString code.
InterlockedIncrement is a physical native string/atomic fixture reached through unchanged original CString code.
InterlockedDecrement is a physical native string/atomic fixture reached through unchanged original CString code.
UpdateWindow is a physical native service; cases supply only platform window/cursor/queue results.
ShowCursor is a physical native service; cases supply only platform window/cursor/queue results.
PeekMessageA is a physical native service; cases supply only platform window/cursor/queue results.
notes: Boundary reviewed against original v1.0 disassembly. Canonical election of 0x429b70 preserves legacy application_level_progression ownership and reuses that body. All unlisted game callees execute unchanged original code; 0x4a30e0 consumes the genuine x87 conversion operand.
